messages:
Maya: Quick update — AV team reports encoder spike, need to cut All-Hands to 55 mins. Proposal: Leadership AMA 20m, Product updates 20m, Q&A lightning round 15m. Move roadmap deep-dive to next Thursday. Thoughts? @here

Devon: Fine with that. Are captions ready? last time captions lagged.

Sanjay (Eng Runtime): Seeing transient frame drops in stage recorder, switching to fallback ingest now.

ops-bot: Recording started: allhands-2026-03-23.mp4 (ID abc123)

Ellie (Comms): Need at least 2 mins at end for org announcements — can we shave product update to 18?

Maya: Good call Ellie — shorten product update to 18, Q&A 17. Will ping leadership to tighten up slides. :thumbsup: 

Jamal (Infra): If captions are failing, switch to real-time fallback -> AWS Transcribe — command below:
```bash
./run_transcribe_fallback --stream-id=allhands-2026 --region=us-west-2
```

Devon: On it. Also toggling OBS keyframe interval to 2s, lower bitrate to 4.5M to reduce spikes.

Sanjay (Eng Runtime): Confirmed ingest switched to fallback ingest-host-2. Monitoring logs.
`log tail --follow /var/log/recorder` shows no frame drops in last 10s.

Maya: Awesome. Ellie can you handle the captions callout during opening slide? Also, recordbot, please pin the Q&A form link in #general.

Ellie (Comms): Yep. Pinned and announced. Preparing a 30s script for the caption ask.

ops-bot: Caption service switched to transcribe-fallback. Latency ~6s. Reaction: :white_check_mark: 

Devon: Quick heads-up — if anyone on the call is presenting slides with animations, ask them to disable transitions; consumes CPU on encoder.

Jamal (Infra): Also enabling autosnapshot for the recorder VM in case we need rollback: `gcloud compute instances snapshot recorder-01 --zone=us-west2-a`

Maya: Thanks team. Final check: anyone need to present who isn't in staging meeting? @Product leads

Priya (Product): I'm presenting rapid-fire metrics, will keep slides to max 6. Confirmed.

Maya: Great. I'm posting the updated agenda in calendar now. Start in 8 minutes. If stream degrades, fallback policy: 1) lower bitrate, 2) transcribe captions, 3) end recording and continue in town-hall audio-only. Keep comms in this thread.
